stage_law: profile_baseline != duty_defined != assembly_target_defined != rule_validated != action_proven != trust_proven != throne_confirmed != organ_assembled
purpose: Score organ maturity by separate truth stages without inflating operational/trust readiness from duty or assembly target definitions.

duty_defined_score.meaning: Machine-readable duty contract exists and validates.

assembly_target_defined_score.meaning: Machine-readable assembly target exists and validates.

rule_validated_score.meaning: Rules and forbidden actions validated by rule validators.

action_proven_score.meaning: Organ performed profile action with receipt/replay evidence.

trust_proven_score.meaning: Custodes/Inquisition/Throne trust chain confirms action evidence.

throne_confirmed_score.meaning: Throne confirms truth stage from cross-organ evidence.

organ_assembled_score.meaning: All assembly gates proven and Crown-confirmed.

hard_rules: organ_assembled_score must remain 0 unless every assembly gate is PROVEN and Throne confirmed
red_team_layer_score and blue_team_layer_score must remain 0 while their gates are NOT_PROVEN
path existence is not functionality proof
profile baseline is not implementation proof
